//: The observability containment register (gate: observability, tools/check-observability.mjs). vendorSpecifiers is the telemetry-SDK detector — it may be EXTENDED for a vendor the shipped floor has never heard of, never narrowed below REQUIRED_VENDOR_FLOOR in tools/lib/observability.mjs (the gate reds a missing floor entry). redactionSymbols is the closed list of passes a sink may declare — extend-only the same way (module patches APPEND their symbols, e.g. redactCrashEvent/redactText; REQUIRED_REDACTION_FLOOR keeps 'redactFields'), and it must stay a non-empty array of non-empty strings. sinks[] is the reviewed register of the ONLY files allowed to import a vendor telemetry SDK: each entry is { file, vendors, redaction, reason } — the file must import a listed vendor, reference its redaction symbol in code (identifier-boundary match), and carry a reason of 40+ characters, because registering a sink is licensing an off-device egress path for operational data (see packages/platform/observability/src/index.ts, 'NO VENDOR SDK, on purpose'). One exception in kind: { file, vendors, kind: 'buildConfig', reason } licenses a vendor require in a BUILD-CONFIG file (metro.config.js, next.config.*, babel.config.* only) without a redaction symbol — a bundler plugin registration transports no event; any other file or kind value reds. The shipped state declares zero sinks: the seam's LogSink is where a vendor transport attaches, behind redactFields, via the crash-reporting/observability module patches — land the sinks[] row in the SAME diff as the patch. Seeded (yours after init) and planted when absent; git-clean-enforced by check-gate-integrity.mjs.
